chapter: Youth, the road and arrival in California
title: New York as home and returning to California
summary: His parents moved to New York, but after a short stay with family in Brooklyn he knew California was where he belonged.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Up until that time, New York had been your home base.

New York was like home, because my mother and dad had moved to New York -- and so I considered New York home. So I went back to New York... I still have family living in Brooklyn, incidentally; they've been in the same house for forty years. So I went back to New York, and I stayed with the family in Brooklyn. I stayed about six weeks, and I couldn't wait to get back to California. I knew that this was the place for me. So I came back, and that's when everything started to really happen with the gigs.
So you've been here pretty much steadily since then.

More or less, yeah. I've been in and out. I was going to mention the... See, I'm jumping around. But I was going to mention the period from when I was in school, when I was the kind of musician I had wanted to be.
